title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17

ai_review.summary: Hot, high‑energy 1982 Warfield show captured on a solid soundboard tape with mostly clear sound and a few hissy patches.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its scorching energy – highlights include the blistering Scarlet → Fire transition, a fiery Estimated Prophet, and tight renditions of Tennessee Jed, Sugar Magnolia and It's All Over Now. The soundboard source delivers a generally nice mix, though a few listeners note hiss and occasional flatness from audience‑patches.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars highlighting strong playing and a good recording; only a few note flatness or low bass, giving an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced sound; some reviewers mention hiss and the effect of AUD patches that can make parts sound flat or a bit noisy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set that builds into a high‑energy second set; notable transitions such as Scarlet → Fire and the seamless move into Foolish Heart/Estimated Prophet keep momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Warfield seemed to get Jerry going, driving the band with his signature lead work.
band_member_comments.Phil: A few listeners felt Phil’s bass was buried until later in the set (Loser), though others noted he was solid overall.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob's vocal banter and guitar antics were highlighted as funny and entertaining.
